# `floor`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
floor(expr[, scale])
```

Returns the largest number after rounding down that is not greater than `expr`. An optional `scale` parameter can be specified to control the rounding behavior.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.3.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- floor, example 1
> SELECT floor(-0.1);
-1
```

```sql
-- floor, example 2
> SELECT floor(5);
5
```

```sql
-- floor, example 3
> SELECT floor(3.1411, 3);
3.141
```

```sql
-- floor, example 4
> SELECT floor(3.1411, -3);
0
```
